messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH severity — HorizonBank-EU-VPC — p99 latency breach in eu-west-1 (observed 2:15 UTC). Auto-runbooks attached. Please ack and join #incidents.

oncall_jamie: Acked. I'm taking lead. Confirming scope: dedicated pool hb-eu-dedicated-3, traffic % to pool ~84% for HorizonBank. Who's on the infra side?

sre_lee: I'm here. Seeing p95 ~1.2s -> 2.8s, p99 spiking to 6s. Error rates low (<0.1%) but queue length on pool rising ~x6. GPU util ~98%, scheduler backlog growing.

eng_runtime_chen: Adding some backend metrics: KV cache miss rate jumped from 8% -> 62% in last 20m for HorizonBank tenant keys. Looks like long conversations evicting hot keys.

oncall_jamie: Thanks Chen. Initial hypothesis: tenant-specific KV cache pressure causing extra generation work + batch fragmentation -> higher tail latency. Isolate-by-tenant config confirmed on this dedicated pool?

infra_ops: Confirmed: hb-eu-dedicated-3 is a tenant-isolated pool (exclusive to HorizonBank). We have 6 infer nodes: node IDs n-12..n-17. Memory pressure on n-14 and n-15.

network_ash: No apparent network drops at LB level. Latency between control-plane and nodes stable. No infra network flaps.

oncall_jamie: Short-term mitigation plan (T-0): 1) Enable model-fallback to smaller quantized variant for HorizonBank (reduce tokens/sec cost) 2) Apply soft rate-limit to long-running sessions 3) Route 10% of HorizonBank traffic to eu-central fallback pool while we scale.

eng_runtime_chen: I can flip model-fallback. Proposed variant: redwood-7b-q4f -> redwood-3b-q4. Quality hit minimal on short prompts. Running command now:```sh
# apply model fallback override for tenant
rwdctl routing set-override --tenant HorizonBank --pool hb-eu-dedicated-3 --fallback redwood-3b-q4 --percent 100
```

eng_runtime_chen: Done. Fallback active for the pool (console id: route-override-778). Monitoring latency.

sre_lee: Starting tenant-level rate-limiter for sessions > 120s:```json
{"tenant":"HorizonBank","max_concurrent_sessions":120,"session_duration_threshold_s":120}
```

sre_lee: Rate limiter applied. Notifying customer now?

cust_success_olga: Drafting message. Suggest transparent but brief: "We’ve detected increased latency in eu-west-1, applied temporary mitigations (fallback model + throttling + partial routing to eu-central). No data exposure; we’re working to restore SLO. Will update in 30m." Want to add ETA?

oncall_jamie: Good. Send now and link to our status page and runbook. Keep ETA conservative: 2 hours to stabilize.

cust_success_olga: Sent to HorizonBank (support ticket #HB-8721). They replied: "Thanks, please keep us posted. Peak scheduled batch at 03:00 UTC — can you confirm mitigation will hold?"

infra_ops: Spinning additional node pool instance (scale +2 nodes) behind dedicated pool. Triggering now:```sh
rwdctl infra scale --pool hb-eu-dedicated-3 --add-nodes 2 --type g5x
```

infra_ops: Nodes requested, ETA ~7 min to readiness.

eng_runtime_chen: Observing immediate latency drop on fallback (p95 -> 1.0s) but p99 still elevated for a subset of sessions. Those sessions are mostly >10k tokens; KV cache misses persist.

sre_lee: For the long-running sessions we can enable KV-prefetch for HorizonBank to warm caches on routing changes. That reduces cold misses but increases memory. Need infra signoff.

infra_ops: Memory headroom limited until new nodes join. We can enable prefetch only for sessions flagged as high-impact. Implementing selective prefetch via routing hook.```py
# selective prefetch pseudo
if session.tokens > 5000 and tenant == 'HorizonBank':
    prefetch_kv(session)
```

eng_runtime_chen: Deployed selective prefetch for large sessions. Monitoring: KV miss rate dropping from 62% -> 28% over 3m.

network_ash: LB metrics show the 10% redirected to eu-central healthy. No TLS errors.

infra_ops: New nodes (n-18,n-19) are up and joined the pool. Rebalancing connections now.

sre_lee: Rebalance done. GPU util normalized to ~72% across pool. p99 now ~1.4s. We'll keep monitoring for 30m.

oncall_jamie: Handing off to Lee for the next shift. Key open items for overnight: 1) verify HorizonBank’s 03:00 batch, 2) monitor KV miss rate and early-warning alerts, 3) keep fallback in place until stable. If re-blast, escalate to oncall + platform lead.

sre_lee: Taking over. I'll post a status update every 15m.

cust_success_olga: Sent update to HorizonBank: "We routed 10% to eu-central, enabled fallback q3->3b, applied selective prefetch and scaled pool. p99 improved to ~1.4s. We'll monitor through your 03:00 batch and follow up."

oncall_jamie: Adding post-incident actions: - Investigate long-conversation eviction strategy (consider sticky caching or per-conversation cap) - Add tenant KV-miss alert threshold to paging rules - Run load test simulating large conversation churn on dedicated pools

eng_runtime_chen: Agreed. I’ll open an RFC for sticky conversation caches and a small experiment to see impact on memory vs latency.

incident-bot: NOTE: Incident auto-log created (id: INC-2026-0458). Severity downgraded to HIGH->MED after stabilization.

sre_lee: Marking channel for follow-up thread tomorrow morning for root cause. For now, leaving overrides active and will remove fallback after 4 hours of stable metrics.

cust_success_olga: HorizonBank responded: ":thumbsup: thanks for the quick action. Please share RCA when available"

oncall_jamie: Thanks team. Closing active war-room. Handoff complete to Lee.

sre_lee: 15m status: p95=0.9s p99=1.3s KV-miss=22% queue-length normalized. Logging off in 45m unless new alerts.

network_ash: adding note to postmortem: check region routing capacity and failover playbook for dedicated tenant pools.

incident-bot: This thread will be archived when last message is 3 hours old.
